# What each vendor folder is FOR, one line each: <path>  <status>  # reason
# Statuses: current (this design uses it), v1 (the built V1 kits only, not the V2 board set),
#           retired (superseded by a ruling; kept for the record), tooling (not a document).
#
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. A document store answers with whatever it holds, and this folder holds the
# whole history: the u-blox receiver that the Quectel ruling replaced, the Touch Display 2 that the
# Xenarc replaced, the DMR858M that was dropped from both kits. A retrieval that returns a retired
# part's page with the same standing as a current one does not merely waste a minute; it is the
# exact shape of the defect this repository has already paid for twice, a confident claim about a
# part nobody re-read (a TPS2065CDBV on a SOT-23-6 land for four board phases).
#
# So: kb_search.py LABELS every hit with the status of its folder and pushes a retired one down the
# ranking, and kb_verify.py FAILS when a vendor folder has no line here. A new folder cannot enter
# the store as "current" by default, and a retirement is a line with a ruling behind it rather than
# something a session is expected to remember.
#
# A file line overrides its folder line. Written 10 September 2026 (MESHSAT-862), each reason
# traceable to a ruling in the design record or to the generator that instantiates the part.
